scope.place_or_system: bounded territory, institution or supply system
scope.period: bounded historical, current or prospective window
scope.question: decision that could change after the comparison

evidence.claim: observable claim used by the scenario
evidence.source: primary source, dataset, interview protocol or bounded field record
evidence.limits: missingness, bias, access or safety limit

state.irreversibilities: named thresholds and why they matter

action_ontology.public_semantics: what this action physically and institutionally does

fairness.rival_predicted_to_do_better_on: at least one named axis or condition

reversal_conditions: observable result requiring revision of a live conclusion

safety_and_privacy.publication_constraints: aggregate, anonymize or withhold operational details when necessary
